cards.ex: We need to address the underlying issue, not just treat the symptoms.
cards.exUz: Biz faqat alomatlarni davolamasdan, asosiy muammoga e'tibor qaratishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoning yuzaga kelishiga sabab bo'lgan asosiy, ko'rinmas muammo.

cards.ex: Their negotiations hit the buffers because they couldn't agree on the price.
cards.exUz: Narx bo'yicha kelisha olmaganlari sababli, ularning muzokaralari to'xtab qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Reja yoki harakat muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchramoq, to'xtab qolmoq.

cards.ex: It was a tough call, but I think I made the right decision.
cards.exUz: Bu qiyin qaror edi, lekin men to'g'ri qaror qildim deb o'ylayman.
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilish qiyin bo'lgan qaror.

cards.ex: Unfortunately, our travel plans fell through at the last minute.
cards.exUz: Afsuski, bizning sayohat rejalarimiz oxirgi daqiqada amalga oshmay qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Reja yoki tadbir amalga oshmay qolmoq.

cards.ex: I had to jump through hoops to get my visa approved.
cards.exUz: Vizani tasdiqlatish uchun ko'p harakat qilishimga to'g'ri keldi.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir erishish uchun ko'p qiyinchiliklarni boshdan kechirmoq.

cards.ex: Their plan to cut costs backfired on them when employees started quitting.
cards.exUz: Xarajatlarni qisqartirish rejalari xodimlar ishdan bo'shay boshlaganida ularga teskari ta'sir qildi.
cards.uzDef: Rejalashtirilganidan teskari natija bermoq.

cards.ex: The company is in dire straits and might have to close down.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya juda og'ir ahvolda va yopilishiga to'g'ri kelishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Juda og'ir, xavfli vaziyatda bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: This new law is just a sticking plaster solution to a much bigger problem.
cards.exUz: Bu yangi qonun - katta muammoga vaqtinchalik yechim.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni vaqtinchalik hal qiluvchi, lekin asosiy muammoni bartaraf etmaydigan yechim.

cards.ex: She's on the horns of a dilemma: should she stay in her job or leave for a new one?
cards.exUz: U ikki o't orasida: ishida qolishi kerakmi yoki yangi ishga ketishi kerakmi?
cards.uzDef: Ikki qiyin tanlovdan birini qilishga majbur bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: I needed to get it off my chest, so I told her everything that was bothering me.
cards.exUz: Menga dardimni aytish kerak edi, shuning uchun men unga meni bezovta qilayotgan hamma narsani aytdim.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni bezovta qilayotgan narsani aytib yengillashmoq.

cards.ex: The authorities can't continue to turn a blind eye to the corruption.
cards.exUz: Hukumat korrupsiyaga ko'z yumishda davom eta olmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri yoki noqonuniy narsani bilib turib, ko'rmaslikka olmoq.

cards.ex: I think I bit off more than I could chew when I agreed to organize the whole conference.
cards.exUz: Men butun konferensiyani tashkil qilishga rozi bo'lganimda, o'ylashimcha, men ko'p vazifa oldim.
cards.uzDef: Bajarishga qodir bo'lganidan ko'ra ko'proq vazifani o'z zimmasiga olmoq.

cards.ex: The company's poor results were a wake-up call, and they started making changes.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning yomon natijalari ogohlantiruvchi qo'ng'iroq bo'ldi va ular o'zgarishlar qila boshladilar.
cards.uzDef: Xavf yoki muammo haqida ogohlantiruvchi hodisa.

cards.ex: The builder cut corners and used cheap materials, which caused problems later.
cards.exUz: Quruvchi tejamkorlik qilib, arzon materiallardan foydalangan, bu keyinchalik muammolarni keltirib chiqardi.
cards.uzDef: Sifatni pasaytirib, pul yoki vaqtni tejash uchun qisqa yo'ldan bormoq.

cards.ex: The new paint job just papers over the cracks; the house needs major repairs.
cards.exUz: Yangi bo'yoq faqat nuqsonlarni yashiradi; uyga katta ta'mirlash kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoning haqiqiy sababini hal qilmasdan, faqat tashqi ko'rinishini yaxshilashga harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: Investigating the company's finances could open a real can of worms.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning moliyasini tekshirish haqiqiy muammolar to'plamini ochishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Muammolarni hal qilishda yangi, kutilmagan muammolarni keltirib chiqaradigan vaziyat.

cards.ex: The economy is finally on the mend after a long recession.
cards.exUz: Uzoq davom etgan retsessiyadan so'ng iqtisodiyot nihoyat tuzalmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Muammoli vaziyatdan asta-sekin yaxshilanmoqda.

cards.ex: I don't want to rock the boat, but I think we need to address this issue.
cards.exUz: Men vaziyatni buzmoqchi emasman, lekin o'ylaymanki, biz bu masalani hal qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni yoki mavjud tartibni o'zgartirishga harakat qilib, muammo keltirib chiqarmoq.

cards.ex: Many good ideas fall by the wayside because of lack of funding.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina yaxshi g'oyalar mablag' etishmasligi sababli qolib ketadi.
cards.uzDef: Rojada muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchramoq yoki unut bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: You need to get your act together if you want to pass the exam.
cards.exUz: Agar imtihondan o'tmoqchi bo'lsangiz, o'zingizni qo'lga olishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tartibli bo'lmoq, o'zini tuta bilmoq, yaxshiroq ishlamoq.

cards.ex: I felt completely out of my depth in the meeting about financial strategy.
cards.exUz: Moliyaviy strategiya haqidagi yig'ilishda men o'z sohamdan tashqarida ekanligimni his qildim.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni hal qilish uchun bilim yoki tajribaga ega bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: You can't just bury your head in the sand and ignore the problem; it will only get worse.
cards.exUz: Siz shunchaki boshingizni qumga tiqib, muammoni e'tiborsiz qoldira olmaysiz; u faqat yomonlashadi.
cards.term: bury your head in the sand
cards.uzDef: Muammoni e'tiborsiz qoldirmoq, uni yo'q deb hisoblash.

cards.ex: Losing the game was a bitter pill to swallow, but we'll learn from it.
cards.exUz: O'yinda mag'lubiyatga uchrash achchiq haqiqat edi, lekin biz bundan saboq olamiz.
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilish qiyin bo'lgan, yoqimsiz haqiqat.

cards.ex: The elephant in the room is that nobody knows how to fix this problem.
cards.exUz: Asosiy muammo shundaki, hech kim bu muammoni qanday hal qilishni bilmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Hamma biladigan, lekin hech kim gapirishni istamaydigan muhim muammo.

cards.ex: The unexpected power outage threw a wrench in the works, and we had to postpone the meeting.
cards.exUz: Kutilmagan elektr uzilishi rejalarni buzdi va biz yig'ilishni keyinga qoldirishimiz kerak edi.
cards.term: throw a wrench in the works
cards.uzDef: Rejani buzmoq, muammolar yaratmoq.

cards.ex: The project failed, so we have to go back to the drawing board.
cards.exUz: Loyiha muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi, shuning uchun biz boshidan boshlashimiz kerak.
cards.term: go back to the drawing board
cards.uzDef: Yangi reja tuzish uchun boshidan boshlamoq.

cards.ex: He's stuck in a vicious circle of debt and unemployment.
cards.exUz: U qarz va ishsizlik aylanasi bo'ylab harakatlanmoqda.
cards.uzDef: O'zini-o'zi kuchaytiradigan, yomonlashuvchi vaziyat.

cards.ex: After his arrest, he decided to turn over a new leaf and get his life back on track.
cards.exUz: Qamoqqa olinganidan so'ng, u yangi hayot boshlashga va hayotini o'z iziga tushirishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: O'z xatti-harakatlarini yaxshilamoq, yangi hayot boshlamoq.

cards.ex: It might be difficult now, but in the long run, it will be worth it.
cards.exUz: Hozir qiyin bo'lishi mumkin, lekin uzoq muddatda bunga arziydi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda, uzoq vaqt o'tgandan keyin.

cards.ex: I tried to smooth things over after the argument, but she was still angry.
cards.exUz: Men janjaldan keyin vaziyatni yumshatishga harakat qildim, lekin u hali ham g'azablangan edi.
cards.uzDef: Kelishmovchiliklarni bartaraf etib, vaziyatni yumshatmoq.
